summary.source: https://nlp-qcet.github.io/ (Belz et al., 2025); 6 extension leaves added (4 from HDBSCAN clustering, 2 from frequency analysis)
summary.extension_note: 6 new leaf nodes added to extend QCET for emerging NLG evaluation criteria (2020-2025 corpus analysis). QOC-c-3 (Reasoning Correctness) and QIC-c-6 (Attribution/Citation Correctness) were initially proposed but dropped: reclassification showed items dispersed to existing QCET leaves, indicating insufficient corpus signal to justify new nodes. QIC-f-3 (Instruction Format Compliance) and QIC-c-5 (Instruction Content Compliance) were also dropped: Stage 3 empirical analysis folded instruction-following variants into QIC-c-3, contradicting the proposed additions, and corpus frequency was below threshold.

nodes.notes:

nodes.short_definition: A better system produces outputs that are estimated to be more likely by a given external model
nodes.notes: The more common use of perplexity is in evaluations where _low_ perplexity as computed with a given model is desirable, where it's seen as indicative of \`natural' output. However, it can equally be desirable for outputs to have high perplexity, e.g. in situation where a different style from that encapsulated by the model is intended. \[QEF-w-9\] Model Perplexity is a Feature-type QC, hence captures both possibilities. Note that various metrics exist for measuring model perplexity including normalised ones such as SLOR.

nodes.name: Absence of Toxic / Harmful Content
nodes.short_definition: A better system produces outputs with less toxic, harmful, or offensive content
nodes.notes: Covers safety, harmlessness, toxicity, and offensiveness evaluated intrinsically (without reference to a specific external norm). Cf. [QEC-w-2] Refusal Appropriateness (behaviour-level) and [QEC-c-3] Absence of Bias/Stereotypes (fairness-norm-referenced).

nodes.level1_name: Quality of outputs in their own right
nodes.name: Creativity/Non-creativity (outputs as a whole)
nodes.short_definition: A better system produces outputs that are more (or less) creative and original
nodes.notes: Covers creativity, originality, novelty, and innovativeness assessed holistically. Cf. [QOF-w-1] Diversity, [QOF-w-5] Humorousness. This is a *Feature* node (direction depends on task).

nodes.level1_name: Quality of outputs relative to a specified external frame of reference
nodes.name: Absence of Bias / Stereotypes
nodes.short_definition: A better system produces outputs with fewer biases or stereotypes relative to fairness norms
nodes.notes: Covers demographic bias, gender bias, racial stereotypes, neutrality, and fairness relative to external ethical or social norms. Cf. [QOC-c-2] Absence of Toxic/Harmful Content (intrinsic safety) and [QEC-w-2] Refusal Appropriateness.

nodes.level1_name: Quality of outputs relative to a specified external frame of reference
nodes.name: Refusal Appropriateness
nodes.short_definition: A better system appropriately refuses harmful or out-of-scope requests without over-refusing benign ones
nodes.notes: Covers refusal detection, refusal rate calibration, and alignment of refusal behaviour with safety and policy norms. Distinct from [QOC-c-2] Absence of Toxic/Harmful Content (about response content) and [QEC-w-1] Functional Correctness.

nodes.level1_name: Quality of outputs relative to a specified external frame of reference
nodes.name: Engagingness/Interestingness
nodes.short_definition: A better system produces outputs that users find more engaging or interesting
nodes.notes: Covers engagingness, interestingness, persuasiveness, and overall user preference assessed holistically as a feature. Cf. [QEF-w-2] Effect on User Behaviour (downstream behavioural change) and [QEF-w-3] Effect on User Emotion. This is a *Feature* node.

nodes.level1_name: Quality of outputs relative to a specified external frame of reference
nodes.name: Empathy / Emotional Appropriateness
nodes.short_definition: A better system produces outputs that more appropriately reflect or respond to the user's emotional state
nodes.notes: Covers empathy, emotional support, emotional expression, and emotional tone calibration. Particularly relevant for dialogue, counselling, and affective computing tasks. Cf. [QEF-w-3] Effect on User Emotion (measured downstream emotional change).
